item.title: Why a Christian group is suing the Dutch government for West Bank trade ban
item.description: The Israeli Product Centre says it has not been given enough time to sell off its stock.

item.title: Israel extends campaign against UNRWA to advance West Bank annexation
item.description: Raid on UNRWA centre exposes Israel's strategic push to erase refugee rights, seal West Bank annexation, analysts say.

item.title: Kremlin says CIA head met Russian intelligence officials, but not Putin
item.description: CIA's Ratcliffe has met with Russian intel officials in Moscow, but not President Putin; Kremlin calls talks 'positive'.

item.title: Meta agrees to settlement, platform changes in youth addiction case
item.description: Meta settles $16.68bn lawsuit over child addiction claims, agreeing to major changes in Facebook and Instagram features.

item.title: Trump tells Al Jazeera ‘not in a hurry’ for Iran to return to talks
item.description: 'I have no time schedule,' Trump says when asked when he expects Iran to return to the negotiating table.

item.title: Bodies of missing people found in Korea becomes national scandal
item.description: A police officer has been arrested after the bodies of four missing people were found on Jeju Island in South Korea.

item.title: Children in Gaza fear flying their kites after Israeli threat
item.description: A 10-year-old boy who makes kites says he is afraid to fly them after Israel threatened to treat kites as acts of war.

item.title: Why northern Mozambique’s surging violence is worsening displacement crisis
item.description: Over 100,000 people displaced last year alone, adding to the 1.3 million people already forced to flee from their homes.

item.title: Locked inside: Grief and anger as Pakistan hospital fire kills 14 newborns
item.description: A nursery for critical infants — supposedly the safest place in Islamabad's PIMS hospital — turned into a deathtrap.

item.title: Callaway apologises after golf ad slammed for depicting domestic violence
item.description: The advert, which was released online last week before being pulled, prompted calls for a boycott of Callaway products.

item.title: A teacher’s slap, student’s death revive India’s corporal punishment debate
item.description: Teja's death raises question India has not fully answered: why more than a decade after ban is hitting children routine?

item.title: ICC chief urges Japan to counter US pressure on the court
item.description: Washington escalated its campaign against the ICC last week by sanctioning its president and a senior trial lawyer.

item.title: Deadly flash floods sweep through northern Nepal
item.description: Flash floods have swept through northern Nepal, killing at least eight people and washing away homes.

item.title: CCTV captures terrifying mudslide engulfing Nepal-China border
item.description: CCTV footage shows people fleeing seconds before a massive mudslide engulfs a crossing on the Nepal-China border.

item.title: When is the Champions League draw, which teams are in, and what are the dates?
item.description: Thirty-six teams will learn their fate in a draw for the group phase, which will be followed by knockout rounds.

item.title: Photos: Avalanche floods kill eight, hundreds missing in Nepal’s Himalayas
item.description: Flash floods devastate Nepal's Himalayas, washing away villages and infrastructure along the Bhotekoshi river.

item.title: England footballer Sterling charged with dangerous driving after collision
item.description: Raheem Sterling has also been accused of possession ​of nitrous oxide and will appear in court on September 15.

item.title: Iran, Oman agree on temporary Hormuz route: What we know
item.description: Iran’s deputy foreign minister announced a temporary shipping corridor in the Strait of Hormuz.

item.title: Dead whale washes ashore on beach in Mexico
item.description: A roughly 12-metre-long whale has been found dead on a beach in Tijuana, Mexico.

item.title: Why India is sharing missile secrets with its private sector
item.description: New policy allows India’s private sector to produce advanced weaponry, supporting its goal of military self-sufficiency.

item.title: Mother and daughter detained by ICE in hospital after car crash
item.description: Mother and daughter detained by ICE in hospital after car crash

item.title: Photos: Thousands join Spain’s La Tomatina festival for epic tomato battle
item.description: About 20,000 participants hurled 165 tonnes of tomatoes in Bunol's streets during Spain's famed La Tomatina festival.

item.title: Manchester City sign teenage Moroccan midfielder Ayyoub Bouaddi from Lille
item.description: Sought-after Bouaddi joins the Premier League club on a five-year deal worth $117m.

item.title: Infantino has no future at FIFA, says European Leagues chief
item.description: Claudius Schaefer insists the influence of the FIFA president has 'grown from year to year'.

item.title: China’s Xi to visit Kyrgyzstan, Egypt
item.description: The Chinese president will attend the SCO summit in Bishkek, before travelling to Egypt.
